# ErrorState

Error state: shown instead of the content when loading fails, with the reason and a way to retry. Never hide an
error behind an empty state or an empty table.

**Category**: Feedback · **Common uses**: Failed requests for a list or details, lost connection to a service, missing permissions

## Import

```ts
import { ErrorState } from 'vellum-ui'
```

## Basic usage

Replaces the content when a request fails and offers a retry. `message` is converted, user-readable text; do
not show the raw exception.

```tsx
export function Basic() {
  return (
    <ErrorState
      message='The project "Website redesign" cannot be loaded right now: the network is unreachable'
      onRetry={() => {}}
    />
  )
}
```

## Variants

### Small, inside a panel

```tsx
export function Small() {
  return <ErrorState size="sm" message="You do not have permission to view this folder" />
}
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `ReactNode` | Title, "Failed to load" by default. | — | No |
| `message` | `ReactNode` | Description of the error: a text readable by users, converted from the error; never show the raw exception. | — | No |
| `onRetry` | `() => void` | Retry: when provided, a "Retry" button is shown. | — | No |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md'` | Size: `md` for a whole page or a large area, `sm` inside lists and panels. | `'md'` | No |
| `fill` | `boolean` | Fills the height of the parent and centers the content. | — | No |

Also accepts `testId` (rendered as `data-testid`), `aria-label`, `role` and `id`, like all primitives.

Does not accept `style` or `className`: appearance is adjusted only through the semantic props above and the theme.
